run_hiplot_server: run a HiPlot Flask server with experiment fetchers on a specified host and port
run_server_with_fetchers: run the HiPlot server with a list of ExperimentFetcher functions to serve experiment data
run_server_main_cli: run the HiPlot webserver from the command line with host, port, and fetcher arguments
serve_experiment_data_endpoint: serve experiment data via the /data endpoint by loading experiments through registered fetchers
run_server_in_debug_mode: run the HiPlot server in Flask debug mode with file modification watching enabled
